info.title: Valhalla Server API
info.description:
REST API of the **Valhalla** healthcare backend (Drogon / C++20, PostgreSQL). Base URL: `http://<host>:<port>/api/v2` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v2`).

Open the **API Guide** (blue button, bottom right) for authentication, permissions, data model, validation, errors, configuration and recipes, and the **Test console** (green button) to run every endpoint with dummy data.

tags.name: Providers
tags.description:
Accounts for healthcare professionals.

**Permissions:** `create` and `login` are public. `read`, `update`, `delete`, `activate`, `suspend`, `services` and `logout` work only on **your own** account (`403` otherwise). `search` needs any valid token.

tags.name: Users
tags.description:
Patient-side accounts.

**Permissions:** `create` and `login` are public. `read`, `update`, `delete`, `activate`, `suspend`, `services` and `logout` work only on **your own** account (`403` otherwise). `search` needs any valid token.

tags.name: Clinics
tags.description:
Clinics (the service patients and visits belong to).

**Permissions:** `create` - a provider, with `owner_id` and `admin_id` equal to their own id. `read` - owner, admin or staff with `CAN_READ` (`0x04`); `update` - owner, admin or staff with `CAN_WRITE` (`0x08`); `delete` - **owner only**.

tags.name: Pharmacies
tags.description:
Pharmacy services.

**Permissions:** same as clinics: create = provider (own id as owner and admin); read = staff `CAN_READ` (`0x04`); update = staff `CAN_WRITE` (`0x08`); delete = owner only. Owner and admin always pass.

tags.name: Laboratories
tags.description:
Laboratory services.

**Permissions:** same as clinics: create = provider (own id as owner and admin); read = staff `CAN_READ` (`0x04`); update = staff `CAN_WRITE` (`0x08`); delete = owner only. Owner and admin always pass.

tags.name: Radiology centers
tags.description:
Radiology services.

**Permissions:** same as clinics: create = provider (own id as owner and admin); read = staff `CAN_READ` (`0x04`); update = staff `CAN_WRITE` (`0x08`); delete = owner only. Owner and admin always pass.

tags.name: Patients
tags.description:
Patients registered in a clinic.

**Permissions:** the owner or admin of the patient's clinic, or clinic staff with the matching bit: read `0x04`, create/update `0x08`, delete `0x10`. Columns: `clinic_id`, `fullname`, `phone`, `city`, `dob` (`yyyy-mm-dd`), `gender`, `marital`, `job` required; `email`, `address` optional.

tags.name: Patient records
tags.description:
One record set per patient. `id` is the patient id. Delete is not supported (cascade from the patient).

**Permissions:** same as patients (clinic owner, admin, or staff with the matching bit: read `0x04`, create/update `0x08`). One row per patient, keyed by the patient id; create it once, then update.

tags.name: Visits
tags.description:
Visits of a patient.

**Permissions:** clinic owner, admin, or staff with read `0x04`, create/update `0x08`, delete `0x10`. Columns: `patient_id`, `clinic_id`; optional `visit_date`, `visit_time`, `complaints`, `symptoms`, `examination` (JSON), `diagnosis`, `comments`. Deleting a visit also removes its requests, prescriptions and paid services.

tags.name: Visit records
tags.description:
One record set per visit. `id` is the visit id. Delete is not supported (cascade from the visit).

**Permissions:** same as visits. One row per visit, keyed by the visit id.

tags.name: Appointments
tags.description:
Bookings between a user and a provider at a clinic.

**Permissions:** clinic owner, admin, or staff with read `0x04`, create/update `0x08`, delete `0x10`. Needs an existing `clinic_id`, `user_id` and `provider_id`. Appointment dates are `yyyy-mm-dd`, times `hh:mm:ss`.

tags.name: Staff
tags.description:
Manage who works for a clinic, pharmacy, laboratory or radiology center.

**Permissions:** only the owner or admin of the entity. `staff` is stored as `{"<role>": ["<provider id>:<power>"]}`; the power bit mask is explained in *Permissions* above (read+write+delete = 28).
